context: Merged in #3083 (squash 386ba7519, 2026-10-17). description:
## Problem
- Cloud dry-runs without credentials fall back to `database_config: data_only`. The generator lookup then throws and the error is swallowed (`benchbox/core/dryrun.py:1053-1056`), so the Snowflake and Databricks tuned previews are `null`.
- Generators drive execution only for DuckDB (CTAS SQL), ClickHouse and StarRocks. Elsewhere the preview is generator output that execution does not run, with no disclaimer.
- The DuckDB preview omits the index DDL that execution runs.
- The Athena generator emits a SQL comment ("-- Note: PARTITIONED BY…") instead of partitioning.

## Change
- Use the requested platform type for generator lookup and surface a warning on failure.
- Add a banner for `:preview_only` / non-migrated platforms that cites the registry notes.
- Include the DuckDB index and atomic-sort statements.
- Replace the Athena comment with real `PARTITIONED BY` or an explicit "unsupported" marker.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- Dry-run never executes or records statements.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`.
- Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- No live cloud runs without explicit user approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop d39166ea.
